title: 拼豆小火箭
style: fused plastic bead craft, visible round bead holes, yellow and orange beads, white craft mat
beats: Orange cheek beads rearrange into a tiny rocket
Three red-orange exhaust beads extend below
The rocket rises a short distance
It traces a small curved flight
Exhaust beads retract as it lands
Beads rearrange back into the cheek
